payload: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git fetch origin --prune; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $branch=(git branch --show-current).Trim(); $dirty=@(git status --porcelain); if ($branch -ne 'main') { throw "expected main, got $branch" }; if ($dirty.Count -gt 0) { [pscustomobject]@{stage='preflight';branch=$branch;dirty=$dirty} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 42 }; git pull --ff-only origin main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $tested=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); python plugins/heaven-control-plane/verify.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; .\heaven-bridge\manage.ps1 TEST; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git diff --check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git fetch origin main --quiet; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $local=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); $remote=(git rev-parse origin/main).Trim(); $dirtyAfter=@(git status --porcelain); $exact=($local -eq $remote -and $dirtyAfter.Count -eq 0); [pscustomobject]@{stage='complete';tested_sha=$tested;local_head=$local;remote_main=$remote;exact=$exact;dirty_count=$dirtyAfter.Count} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; if (-not $exact) { exit 43 }
